python.title: PEP 701 – Syntactic formalization of f-strings
python.content: In modern Python, f-strings can contain nested quotes and backslashes. Use for clearer formatting and fewer workarounds.

python.title: What's New in Python 3.14
python.content: Track syntax updates, typing changes, and runtime performance improvements in the active target version.

python.title: Dataclasses and structural typing
python.content: dataclasses.dataclass reduces boilerplate. For structural typing consider Protocol (PEP 544) and runtime_checkable.

python_3_14.title: New type parameter syntax
python_3_14.content: Use this topic for curated notes and migration hints specific to Python 3.14.

architecture_refactor.title: Split god module
architecture_refactor.content: Extract cohesive subsets into new modules; reduce fan-out of the original; update imports.

architecture_refactor.title: Introduce facade
architecture_refactor.content: Create a thin _api.py module that re-exports public symbols. Hide internal implementation; clients import from facade only.

deprecated_api.title: Deprecated API
deprecated_api.content: Check release notes for removed or deprecated APIs; prefer replacement APIs before upgrading. Pin known-good versions if needed.

typing.title: Type hints
typing.content: PEP 484; use typing and typing_extensions. For static checking: mypy, pyright. Keep examples aligned with the active Python target.

typing.title: TYPE_CHECKING and forward refs
typing.content: For type-only imports use if TYPE_CHECKING: ... to avoid runtime cycles. Forward references: 'ClassName' or from __future__ import annotations.

cyclic_imports.title: Break import cycles
cyclic_imports.content: Move shared types to a separate module; use TYPE_CHECKING for type-only imports; or defer imports inside functions.

cyclic_imports.title: Dependency inversion
cyclic_imports.content: Introduce an abstraction layer between modules A and B that import each other. Dependency should flow in one direction only.

version_migration.title: Python version upgrade
version_migration.content: Check What's New and Deprecation sections. Test with target version; update syntax and typing constructs; replace removed stdlib APIs; fix deprecated APIs.

version_migration.title: Dependency upgrade
version_migration.content: Pin or constrain versions; run tests; check CHANGELOG for breaking changes. Use tools: pip-audit, safety.

security.title: Vulnerable dependencies
security.content: Run pip-audit or safety check. Update vulnerable packages; prefer maintained alternatives. Avoid eval, exec on untrusted input.

async_patterns.title: Async/await
async_patterns.content: asyncio; async def, await. Avoid blocking in async code. Use asyncio.run() for top-level. Context managers: async with.

god_module.title: God module smell
god_module.content: Module with too many responsibilities or high fan-out. Split by domain, extract cohesive classes/functions into new modules.

bottleneck.title: Bottleneck module
bottleneck.content: Too many modules depend on one. Introduce facade or split into smaller modules with clear boundaries.
